reproducibility_gaps: The documented master reproducibility entrypoint executes only the Burgers reproduction workflow; the Navier-Stokes and wave experiment surfaces require separate invocation not specified by the master run script.

The archived Code Ocean image is referenced by registry tag and the repository contains a version-pinned Dockerfile, but continued external registry availability is not guaranteed by the Git repository itself.
The Burgers source dynamically selects CUDA when available or CPU otherwise, so exact experimental hardware is not fixed by the pinned source.
Bundled Original trained models and loss-surface arrays are available, but their exact generating environment and run provenance are not individually encoded beside every artifact.
Expected quantitative acceptance thresholds for a successful reproduction are not specified in the bounded documentation.
notes: R2 reflects the immutable source, clear MIT license, explicit reproducibility entrypoint, archived container reference, version-pinned Docker environment, seed control, executable scientific script and bundled result artifacts, while withholding stronger claims requiring execution or fully specified acceptance criteria.
